issue.title: Ensure that `quarkus.uuid` is not determined at native image build time
Data is not read from Kafka by an app in Native mode

labels.name: triage/duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

I have two identical apps deloyed side-by-side, which get messages on rest endpoint, push them to kafka topic, read data from the topic, process it, push it to another topic and when read the results and send them back as server-sent events. After an update to the latest snapshot, I noticed, that one of the apps stopped reading/processing the data in native mode.

### Expected behavior

Both apps should process the data in the same way in both JVM and native mode. The test from the reproducer should succeed.

### Actual behavior

The second app, which proceeds the data later, do not process it (or doesn't read from the kafka topic at all)
The test from the reproducer fails with the following error:
```
ConfluentKafkaAvroGroupIdIT.testSane:12->BaseKafkaAvroGroupIdIT.testSane:44 You should not process more msg than the expected ones ==> expected: <10> but was: <0>
```

### How to Reproduce?

1. `git clone -b reproducer-kafka-sse git@github.com:fedinskiy/quarkus-test-suite.git && cd quarkus-test-suite/messaging/kafka-confluent-avro-reactive-messaging`
2. `mvn clean verify -Dreruns=0 -Dit.test=ConfluentKafkaAvroGroupIdIT -Dnative -Dquarkus.platform.version=3.18.0.CR1`
If we use `-Dquarkus.platform.version=3.17.8` or omit ` -Dnative` the tests succeeds

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

6.12.9-200.fc41.x86_64

### Output of `java -version`

23.0.1, vendor: Eclipse Adoptium

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.18.0.CR1

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

Apache Maven 3.9.6

### Additional information

This was originally caught on a codebase, which used `org.reactivestreams.Publisher` and `quarkus-resteasy`[1]. The behavior is the same.

If endpoint code, which reads from kafka is replaced with in-place generated Multi[2], the test works without any problem

[1] `git@github.com:quarkus-qe/quarkus-test-suite.git`, branch `main`, commit `7211d6a65e6f630c98921633e970c9b76dee1136`
